run_diffusion_dpo_training: run diffusion DPO training on a dataset with LoRA adapters and configurable loss types
parse_training_arguments: parse command-line arguments for diffusion DPO training including dataset, optimizer, and scheduler options
validate_trained_model: validate a trained diffusion model by generating images from prompt templates and logging to wandb or tensorboard
encode_text_prompts: encode text captions into token IDs using a pretrained tokenizer for diffusion model conditioning
save_lora_weights: save trained LoRA adapter weights from a UNet model in diffusers-compatible format
